open_points.subject: prepare_request credential and Host header handling
open_points.text: The headers sent are exactly: one host header, which is the instance's required header named host compared without regard to case, sent verbatim, when one exists, otherwise the authority of base_url exactly as written; accept-encoding with value identity; the instance's other required headers with their values verbatim; the credential header; and, with a body, content-type and content-length;
open_points.other_text: - ResolvedCredential fields (exact, no others exist): header_name: str, header_value: str
open_points.question: Must ResolvedCredential.header_name be constrained not to equal Host without regard to case, or must the requirement that exactly one Host header is sent be changed?

open_points.subject: send_prepared_request response ceiling enforcement
open_points.text: the response body is counted after transfer decoding and read at most to the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SERVICE_RESPONSE_BYTES_MAX constant, a longer body being over the ceiling.
open_points.other_text: 2xx whose body is longer than the imported RELEASE_CEILING_SERVICE_RESPONSE_BYTES_MAX constant, whatever its output ports, or whose body as read contains the bytes of the credential value sent, searched before parsing, or whose outputs do not fit is contract_violation, attempt applied for other classes;
open_points.question: May the implementation read one byte beyond the ceiling to establish that an otherwise length-unknown response is longer, or must it never read more than the ceiling?
